title: Apple Disk Image (DMG) signature
summary: An Apple Disk Image (DMG) begins with the 4-byte magic 0x78 0x01 0x73 0x0D (zlib-compressed UDIF) or has 'koly' (0x6B 0x6F 0x6C 0x79) at the end of the file (trailer).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Magic at end: 'koly' (0x6B 0x6F 0x6C 0x79) in the trailer (last 512 bytes).
DMG is the standard disk image format for macOS.
DMG supports compression, encryption, and code signing.
